decision: The competitor (Haas F1 Team) is fined €5,000.
event_name: Time 18:33 2018 AUSTRALIAN GRAND PRIX 22 - 25 March 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 29) and heard the team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 8 was released from a pit stop in an unsafe condition.
offence: Breach of Article 28.13 (c) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video of the pit stop of Grosjean at 16:49 and heard from the team representatives. The Stewards determined that the car was released in an unsafe condition in beach of Art. 28.13.c, that the team ordered the car stopped immediately, and that the driver stopped as fast as he safely could. In accordance with the Article and precedent, the team is fined €5,000. Tim Mayer Enzo Spano Emanuele Pirro Steve Chopping
title: 2018 Australian Grand Prix 2018 Offence Haas Car 8 Release In An Unsafe Condition Doc 32
to: The Team Manager, Haas F1 Team
